    model = Model(services, limits)

        if event['op'] == 'recv':
            key = (tuple(event['connection']), event['stream'])
            real = wires.get(key)
            if real is not None:
                variant = (position * 7 + seed) % 5
                if variant == 0:
                    event = dict(event, wire=real)
                elif variant == 1:
                    event = dict(event, wire=real.upper())
                elif variant == 2:
                    event = dict(event, wire=real[:-1] + ('0' if real[-1] != '0' else '1'))
                elif variant == 3:
                    event = dict(event, wire=real + ' ')
                else:
                    event = dict(event, wire=None)
                if (position + seed) % 3 == 0 and key in last_delivery:
                    event = dict(event, rid=last_delivery[key])
        got = agent.event(event)
        want = model.do(event)
        if not invariants(agent, event, position, seed):
            return False
        if got != want:

            wires[(tuple(event['connection']), event['stream'])] = got['wire']
        if event['op'] == 'recv' and got.get('ok'):
            last_delivery[(tuple(event['connection']), event['stream'])] = event['rid']
    return True


def run(seed, verbose=False):""")
